svg.desc: Password access, hashed locally with PBKDF2-SHA256 Local AES-encrypted archives you can restore in a click Session protection and a timed lockout after failed logins Finds external drives automatically Runs on macOS and Windows, from source or as an app
svg.text: A private vault for external drives. No cloud, only you and your files.
Password access, hashed locally with PBKDF2-SHA256
Local AES-encrypted archives you can restore in a click
Session protection and a timed lockout after failed logins
Runs on macOS and Windows, from source or as an app
